key_information_units.information: The company reported a net loss of EUR 99,507 for 2025 compared to a net profit of EUR 167,409 in 2024, with basic earnings per share declining to EUR -0.02212 from EUR 0.03721.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Condensed statement of comprehensive income (12M columns) and Note 7

key_information_units.information: Cash balance decreased significantly from EUR 370,856 at end-2024 to EUR 227,911 at end-2025, primarily due to operating cash outflows of EUR 142,945 in 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Condensed cash flow statement (Cash flows from operating activities) and condensed statement of financial position (Cash line)

key_information_units.information: Inventories (land plots for development) increased by EUR 91,262 to EUR 1,562,500 in 2025, reflecting continued investments in the Pärnu real estate project.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 3 Inventories and condensed statement of financial position (Inventories line)

key_information_units.information: Operating performance deteriorated from a profit of EUR 161,649 in 2024 to a loss of EUR 108,021 in 2025, driven mainly by a surge in administrative and general expenses to EUR 108,021 from EUR 63,650.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Condensed statement of comprehensive income (Operating loss/loss and Administrative and general expenses lines) and Note 6

key_information_units.information: In 2024, the company completed material land sales (0.09-hectare for EUR 31,920 and 0.70-hectare for EUR 300,000 excluding VAT), contributing to EUR 331,920 in gain on sales that year; no comparable sales occurred in 2025.
A new detailed planning amendment approved on 29 April 2024 merged previously designated transport land with commercial and production plots, increasing flexibility for partial land sales.
Shareholder structure shifted in 2025 with Väätsa Agro AS emerging as a significant shareholder holding 17.88% of shares, while OÜ Pärnu Holdings retained 39.22%.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 5 Equity (List of shareholders with over 1% holdings)

key_information_units.information: Equity decreased to EUR 1,755,267 (97.24% of total assets) at end-2025 from EUR 1,854,774 (99.13% of total assets) at end-2024, reflecting the impact of the annual net loss.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Condensed statement of financial position (Equity and Total assets lines)
